Welcome to Skooldoggery, where we cut through the noise and bring a common-sense approach to dogs and puppies
We mainly focus on Dog-U-Tainment and puppy advice, but you never know what we might cover next!

Our channel is dedicated to providing expert puppy training advice to help you raise a well-behaved dog who is a joy to live with. Training tricks is only part of the fun of owning a dog, your new best friend needs to be fun to live with too! You don't have to live with a dog who barks at the front door, barges past you when you open it or be bossed around at meal times. Follow our dog training advice to embrace a calmer home life with your pet. 

If you're thinking of getting a dog, we can help you with that too. We produce videos about our favourite breeds of dog so you can learn more about a breed's individual needs to make sure you find the right dog for your lifestyle. 

Hit the subscribe button and watch through our playlists and don't forget to share your story with us.
